notes: Rule 425 filing by SLR Investment Corp. (SLRC, Nasdaq) of its 8-K (event date November 30, 2021) announcing the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated December 1, 2021 with SLR Senior Investment Corp. (SUNS); exhibits included: the Merger Agreement (Ex. 2.1), amended bylaws (Ex. 3.1), joint press release (Ex. 99.1) and investor presentation (Ex. 99.2), all inside document seq 1. Two-step merger: Solstice Merger Sub into SUNS, then SUNS into SLRC (survivor). Exchange ratio is NAV-based and set at closing (SUNS per-share NAV / SLRC per-share NAV, determined within 48 hours of the Effective Time), so exchange_ratio is null; the press release gives an illustrative ratio of approximately 0.7763 SLRC shares per SUNS share based on September 30, 2021 NAVs, not a fixed ratio. Cash only in lieu of fractional shares (cash_per_share null); no collar stated (collar null). Expected close: 'first half of calendar year 2022' (8-K); press release says 'first half of 2022', presentation 'fiscal 1H 2022'. Outside date December 1, 2022 per 8-K and Merger Agreement Section 9.1(b)(ii). No meeting or record date stated. 'other' conditions also include the SLRC base management fee reduction (Letter Agreement) and accuracy of representations. Termination fees payable by a third party acquirer: approximately $25,604,700 (SLRC side) and $7,572,270 (SUNS side). Item 5.03 (bylaws amendment) carries no event of the schema kinds.
